title: LG watch not working with xdrip since wear OS update
body:
The latest Wear OS update has broken the X Drip watch face. On the watch, the xdrip readings often lag, show missed readings when in fact the reading is not missed and at times the watch face appears disconnected from app. I am running the latest nightly on my Pixel 2 which has been consistently performing at 100 % capture rate. 
Please note that prior to the wear OS update all was working just fine.
The update is : Wear OS 2.1 ( Sep 28, 2018)
